name: graph-first-baseline-correction
body: The `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md` rule `Graph first, then file read` covers every code/structure question, discovery and enumeration included, and names both artifact classes (in-graph and out-of-graph). `AGENTS.md` carries the confirm-and-anchor qualifier, and `opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md` rule 5 propagates the ordering to generated agents. This state meets the ordering, dual-class, agent-builder, and test acceptance criteria of `requirements.requirement.graph-first-navigation`; the remaining delta shrinks the out-of-graph list in the navigator prompt and `AGENTS.md`.
